'''Kettleweed''' was a type of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] found in the [[Boiling Sea]] on [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. The algae released bubbles of gas when they died, thus giving its name to the sea. The algae blooms provided [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for the local [[ibbot]]s.<ref name="SoF" />
